method: Each section read in full by a machine-assisted reviewer against the packs and the ground catalogue as of this date; not a legal review.

sections.bearsOn: Sets visual quality objectives for the scenic areas of the district's TSA portion on the August 31, 2005 map; a block visible from a significant public viewpoint must keep alteration within the category.
sections.gapNote: Rules now name the order and test the alteration entered from the visual quality page against the category; the planner does not read that page’s measurement itself.

sections.bearsOn: Ties the VQOs to the scenic areas carried forward under FRPA s. 180 and updated and designated under GAR s. 7(1) by the order published September 22, 2005.
Says where the order and map can be viewed.
